page: OVHcloud b3-64 is a General Purpose cloud server powered by an AMD EPYC processor with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at 2.3 GHz. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under a KVM hypervisor, this instance features a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is provided via a local 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth alongside one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance in specific memory and single-core operations. The server achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core CPU performance and large-block memory bandwidth tests, including both read and write operations for 256 MB blocks. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark memory scores also rank in the top 25%. Conversely, multi-core CPU performance, database operations, and Redis SET operations fall within the average range.

With dedicated CPU allocation and a balanced resource profile, the b3-64 offers predictable performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring consistent CPU and memory access. The instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, medium-scale database operations, web serving, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks that benefit from dedicated AMD EPYC cores and local NVMe storage.
